function: Joint CSI feedback and multiuser precoding: DJSCC-compressed eigenvectors feed precoding-direction and power-allocation networks that output the BS precoder maximizing downlink sum-rate (pp. 1-3).
system: FDD MU-MIMO-OFDM, BS with Nt antennas, K=2 (also 3) users with Nr antennas (sizes not given), no RIS; UMa 1.9 GHz downlink, 2.1 GHz uplink (p. 2, 4).
method: DJSCC CNN/FC encoder-decoder plus fully connected precoding and power-allocation modules, trained end-to-end by maximizing sum-rate (label-free, so unsupervised; paradigm not named) with Adam (pp. 1, 4).
data_channel: Uplink and downlink CSI generated with QuaDRiGa following 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa; 100,000 training, 30,000 validation, 20,000 test sample pairs; no public dataset or measurements (p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained with uplink SNR uniform in [-10, 10] dB, tested in that range; feedback size n=32-512 and K=2 or 3 evaluated; same UMa scenario throughout (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: PF_BD_WF, PF (perfect feedback, BD with water-filling). Learned or hybrid: DJSCC (precoder from MSE-trained DJSCC), DJSCC_BD_WF (DJSCC feedback, BD/WF precoding), JFNet (p. 4).
metrics: Downlink sum-rate in bps/Hz versus uplink SNR, feedback overhead n, and number of users (pp. 4-5).
complexity: none (only a qualitative remark on p. 1 that DL precoding is less complex than iterative algorithms, from earlier work).
openness: none (no code or data link; channels generated with QuaDRiGa, p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "generated by QuaDRiGa [14], following the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) TR 38.901 [15]"; training, validation and test sets all come from this generator.
q2_support: p. 5: "During the training stage, both the JFPNet and the DJSCC are trained with mixed uplink SNRs." Only SNR, feedback size n and K=2/3 sweeps are reported, with one UMa scenario; no model trained in one setting is stated to be tested in another.
q3_support: p. 4: "directly using feedback as the precoding matrix and using BD with WF algorithm are also considered as the reference" (non-learned PF, PF_BD_WF); p. 4: "partial CSI eigenvectors recovered by the DJSCC are directly employed as the precoding matrix" (learned DJSCC of [7]); sum-rate compared in Fig. 2.
q4_support: p. 1: "DL based algorithms show lower computational complexity compared to traditional iteration based algorithms" is a qualitative remark on earlier work [9]; pp. 3-5 report no FLOPs, parameter count or runtime for JFPNet, only sum-rate.
q5_support: p. 4: "The uplink CSI and the downlink CSI are generated by QuaDRiGa [14]"; the authors generate their own data, and no code or data link, public dataset or measurement is given.
notes: A correspondence (short research paper), so it is eligible. Area 3 rather than 2: the only metric is downlink sum-rate and the decoder is trained for precoding, not CSI recovery (p. 1: "rather than recovering the source information"). q3 relies on DJSCC, the CSI feedback network of ref. [7] (same group, cited p. 1), as the learned baseline; the reviewer should confirm. JFNet, SFPNet and the w/o JMP and w/o PA curves (p. 4) are variants of the proposed method and are not counted.
